thesis: PGNY is a post-earnings gap winner that is now extended (RSI 73, 11.5% above SMA20) and trading about 4% below the mean analyst target, so most of the good news is priced in. The market regime is risk-off with high confidence: QQQ is below its 50- and 200-day averages, VIX is elevated and tech is leading the decline. Momentum names that have run up on a single print are prone to gap-fill when the tape is weak. Reward/risk is only 1.67 and the technical score is capped at 0.5. The news feed has no confirmed catalyst for the gap and only price-action articles, so the move may be crowded momentum chasing. Quarterly revenue also fell sequentially (Q3 341.3M vs Q2 350.5M) on a thin 24.9% gross margin.
